snippet.title: ShellPieces // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882560/ShellPieces/

ShellPieces is a gauge-based command RPG. 23 unique heroes to form your party! Allies and enemies fight on a 3×3 grid. Skills have different ranges and rows—strategize your formation carefully! Collect powerful legendary gear and create synergies with your characters and party setup!

Developed by
NoWords
